floorPlans.note: Villa figures are internal sellable areas as printed. Pod figures are gross sellable areas. Confirm the selected villa specification and pod option with Aldar.

review.images: Eight Aldar brochure renders depict the villa exterior, rooms, community aerial and paths. Regional stock photos and design swatches were excluded.
review.location: Aldar’s brochure physical page 17 outlines the Lagoons development on eastern Saadiyat Island. Madena provides project-area driving estimates. Property Finder’s estimates differ for Louvre and the airport, so its times are not combined. No verified gate coordinates.
review.floorPlans: Visually reviewed all 56 physical brochure pages. Three complete two-level villa spreads show the internal sellable areas and two distinct optional pod sheets show gross sellable areas. The Madena plan set duplicates these five source layouts, so the full official brochure is the only downloaded original shown.

unavailable: Individual villa entrance coordinates and signed final areas.
